specBaseline.phyProcedures: TS 38.213 (HARQ-ACK timing, SR, PUCCH), TS 38.214 (TBS, TDRA), TS 38.211 (PRACH)

howToRead.steps: Each workflow/case has time-ordered steps. 'time' = SFN/slot at 30 kHz (0.5 ms slots).
howToRead.layers: PHY (PRACH/PDCCH/PUCCH/PBCH), MAC (PDSCH/PUSCH MAC PDUs), RRC, 5GMM/5GSM (inside RRC 'nas'), SIP, SS (test-system action), UE (UE-internal event)
howToRead.rrcMessages: RRC steps carry 'messageRef' into messageLibrary, which holds asn1Type, uperHex, the full decoded IE tree and OCTET-STRING-contained IEs (masterCellGroup -> CellGroupConfig, dedicatedNAS-Message -> NAS).
howToRead.absentIEs: At every SEQUENCE level '_absentOptional' lists root OPTIONAL IEs not present and '_absentExtensions' lists extension-addition IEs not present, so the complete 38.331 IE set is visible for every message.
howToRead.dci: PDCCH steps give DCI format, RNTI, search space, CORESET, aggregation level, every field with bit width and value, total payload bits and payload hex (excluding 24-bit CRC). 'zeroBitFields' lists fields that are 0 bits in this configuration.
howToRead.harq: DL: DCI 1_x -> PDSCH -> PUCCH HARQ-ACK at K1 (Type-2 dynamic codebook, counter DAI). UL: SR -> DCI 0_1 -> PUSCH (Short BSR + SDU); ACK/NACK is implicit via NDI toggling (NR has no PHICH).
howToRead.nasSteps: Every NAS message is its own step (layer 5GMM, 5GSM or EMM) with 'nasMessageRef' into nasLibrary, 'carriedIn' (RRC message / field, or the 5GMM NAS TRANSPORT payload container for 5GSM), 'security' (security header type, MAC placeholder, sequence number, NAS COUNT, protected hex as carried in the RRC container), 'procedure' and 'eps24301Equivalent'. RRC steps list the NAS they carry in 'carriesNAS'.
howToRead.nasLibrary: Per NAS message: TS 24.501 clause, procedure, TS 24.301 equivalent, plain hex, decoded IEs with IEI/length/value, absentOptionalIEs, and containedMessages (payload container, NAS message container, EPS NAS message container).
howToRead.integrity: PDCP MAC-I shown as 0x00000000 before AS security and 0xA5A5A5A5 placeholder after (real value needs KRRCint).
